capabilities: Search the vault and arbitrary local folders with BM25 ranking (Markdown, code, csv, xlsx, docx, pdf)
Read note sections, full notes with frontmatter and links, tables, tags, and folder trees
Keep an in-memory index up to date from Obsidian events
Install Claude Code hooks and a setup skill that redirect Grep/Glob to these tools
Redact tokens and skip sensitive files like .env and SSH keys
disambiguation: Not a UI search replacement; it exposes vault and disk search as MCP tools for AI agents.
extras: Guided setup writes files into the vault's .claude/ folder after a confirmation screen; the folders-outside-index setting currently has no settings tab and is configured only through the guided setup; protection hooks fail open when Obsidian is not running.
intentEvidence: exposed as MCP tools through the AI Ecosystem core
problem: Obsidian's search is a UI feature, so AI agents working in the vault have no programmatic, ranked way to query notes, sections, and other local files.
